dedupe_keys.name: transportportal no norwegian national access point for road and transport data

description: transportportal.no is Norway's national access point for road and transport data. Its data catalogue describes and links to datasets and services on road status, incidents, travel times, public transport, timetables and more, and the portal says all datasets are open and may be used to build services. Everyone in Norway who holds datasets or offers services on road traffic, public transport and mobility can and should publish information about them in the portal, and it notes that every European country must have such an access point under the EU ITS Directive. Coverage: Norway. Format and access: an open metadata catalogue. Licence and cost: open and free, as stated for the datasets. Caveats: the portal catalogues data held by others, so formats vary. It supports network flow and emergency response studies in Norway. It relates to the Statens vegvesen open data portal, the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: transportportal.no: Norwegian national access point for road and transport data
